sentence: From 2022-02-10 to 2026-11-12 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +34.9% a year (worst drawdown -34.2%) against +35.3% (-34.1%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks.
